title: Prove the V4 P9.1 local Web Companion boundary
goal: Implement and certify a loopback-only, non-authoritative Web Companion that invokes one allowlisted V4 Stage flow while preserving four-root confinement and Host verdict authority.
acceptanceCriteria: The Web Companion binds only to loopback and protects mutation with an HTTP-only same-site session plus exact same-origin validation.
Browser input cannot select an executable, shell text, working directory, raw CLI arguments, roots or a non-allowlisted command.
One synthetic Target-to-result request invokes the stable V4 Host stage.run contract and returns the Host JSON and exit code without reinterpretation.
PackageRoot and TargetRoot remain unchanged and runtime writes remain confined to explicit StateRoot and EvidenceRoot paths.
Request injection, session/origin failure and mutable-root overlap fail closed on Windows and Linux.
No V4 Host capability, policy, profile, module, rule, baseline, verdict, workflow, ruleset or remote state changes.
